bio.text: John Garamendi represents California's 8th Congressional District in the U.S. House; he was first elected in a 2009 special election and is serving his eighth term.
He was raised in Mokelumne Hill, California, and earned a B.A. from the University of California, Berkeley, and an MBA from Harvard Business School.
He and his wife served in the Peace Corps in Ethiopia from 1966 to 1968.
Earlier offices include California Insurance Commissioner (1991-1995 and 2003-2006), Deputy Secretary of the Interior (from 1995) and Lieutenant Governor of California (elected 2007).
He is on the ballot for re-election on November 3, 2026.
